summary: Most dossiers rest on solid Twin Cities history and match CURRENT FACTS on the 2026 season, roster moves, Cup, Christmas, MLK Day and Charlotte dates. None contradicts the verified facts on roster, coach or last season. Fixed in place: Edwards mislabelled as Nike-adjacent, the 1986 naming-contest voters, Faribault Woolen Mill's history and name, Hüsker Dü and Twin/Tone, and the Hymie's neighborhood. Also fixed: an invented MEA-break shopping window, the Purple Rain 2019-20 debut stated as fact, and the Oct 30 first-home-game assumption. Still wrong in strategy.json: Purple Rain "ran in 2019-20" and "twice". It also treats the unverified 2026-27 City Edition as a live design brief. It says Hmong New Year coincides with the Nov 24-25 Cup nights, calls Oct 30 the first home game, and has Faribault Mill "since 1865". The rest is a verification queue: small businesses (Askov Finlayson, Loon Cafe, Nike doors, Vinai and other restaurants, Familia), event dates, brand deals, Towns' status and arena naming. No live searches were run because the session search budget is reserved.
